note: Travel hazards for `crossing` nodes. The party walks the stage from one side to the other, then one of these blocks the way. Resolved by js/explore.js; every choice must end in a result, so each crossing needs at least one choice with no requirement. `dc` is a base difficulty: js/explore.js adds 2 per act. Rewards come back in the same shape a won fight returns ({ xp, gold, fame, drops }). R19: js/explore.js now reads this `difficulty` block off the game data (it used to be dead data — the defaults baked into explore.js were what ran).

difficulty.note: A skill check is d20 + one point per three attribute points (js/explore.js checkBonus, rules.js owns the divisor) against the choice's dc plus perAct per act, capped.

crossings.name: The Cold Ford
crossings.intro: The river is wide, brown and moving faster than it looks. The old ford markers are under water.

choices.text: Rig a rope line across
choices.success: One end round a stump, one end round a shoulder. Everyone comes out wet and whole.

choices.text: Wade it, strongest first
choices.success: The current pulls, the line holds, and the packs stay dry.
choices.failure: Somebody goes under and comes up spitting. A sack of food goes downstream.

choices.text: Float the packs and swim the deep channel
choices.success: Cold, fast and over quickly. A drowned traveller's purse is still on the far bank.
choices.failure: The cold gets into everyone. You make the far bank shaking.

choices.text: Walk upstream and look for a shallower crossing
choices.success: Half a day upstream there is a gravel bar you can walk over. Slow, but nobody drowns.

crossings.name: The Scree Gate
crossings.intro: The pass is a throat of loose stone, and the slope above it is still shedding. Something big came down here recently.

choices.text: Time the slides and go across fast
choices.success: Three runs, three gaps in the falling stone, and the pass is behind you.
choices.failure: The slope lets go halfway. Everyone digs out bruised.

choices.text: Shore the worst of it with timber
choices.success: Two props and a crossbeam hold the throat open long enough to walk it.

choices.text: Camp below and wait for the slope to settle
choices.success: A day of listening to stone move. By morning the pass is quiet.

crossings.name: Fever Row
crossings.intro: The only road runs through a village where every second door is chalked. Somebody is coughing behind all of them.

choices.text: Spend bandages and treat who you can
choices.success: You leave clean linen and boiled water behind. A grateful woman presses a keepsake on you.
choices.memory: helped the sick at Fever Row

choices.text: Work out what the sickness is before you walk in
choices.success: It is in the well, not the air. You go round the well and through untouched.
choices.failure: You guess wrong about the air and hold your breath for nothing.

choices.text: Hold cloth over your faces and walk straight through
choices.success: Fast, quiet, and nobody takes anything with them but the smell.
choices.failure: Two of you are sweating by evening.

crossings.name: The Broken Span
crossings.intro: The bridge is two stumps and a gap. Forty feet down, the gorge does not care how you get across.

choices.text: Build a span with timber
choices.success: Three beams, a lot of rope and a plank floor. It creaks, and it holds.
choices.memory: built a bridge over the gorge

choices.text: Climb down and up the other side
choices.success: Down, across the shallows, and up. Somebody finds an old strongbox wedged in the rocks.
choices.failure: A handhold goes. The rope catches, but not before it hurts.

choices.text: Take the long way round
choices.success: An extra day of walking and no gorge at all.

crossings.name: The Toll Stone
crossings.intro: Somebody has dragged a standing stone across the road and painted a price on it. Six of them are sitting behind it, bored and armed.

choices.text: Pay the toll
choices.success: Coin changes hands. The stone gets rolled aside with surprising politeness.

choices.text: Talk them down
choices.success: By the end of it they are apologising and throwing in directions.
choices.failure: They stop listening halfway and reach for the axes.

choices.text: Refuse and take the road
choices.success: The stone gets rolled aside. Nobody asks for money.

crossings.name: The Grey Fen
crossings.intro: The causeway goes into fog and does not obviously come out. There are cairns every hundred paces, when you can see them.

choices.text: Burn a torch and follow the cairns
choices.success: One torch, one cairn at a time. It takes hours and it works.

choices.text: Lead with a light-bearing weapon
choices.success: The glow off the steel is enough to hold the line together.

choices.text: Take a bearing and keep it
choices.success: Counted paces and a fixed heading. You come out exactly where you meant to.
choices.failure: You come out a mile north with wet boots and no dignity.

crossings.name: Windbite Ridge
crossings.intro: The ridge road is exposed for four miles and the weather coming over it is already white.

choices.text: Pitch the tent and go over in the lull
choices.success: You sit the worst of it out under canvas and walk the ridge in clear air.

choices.text: Eat hard and push over in one go
choices.success: Full stomachs and four fast miles. A frozen pack on the verge still has its owner's gear in it.
choices.failure: The wind takes more out of everyone than the food put in.

choices.text: Wait a day in the lee of the rocks
choices.success: A cold, dull day. The ridge is walkable by morning.

crossings.name: The Warden's Gate

guard.name: Gate Warden
guard.greeting: Road's closed past this post. Warden's orders. State your business.
guard.refuse: Then state it somewhere else. Turn around.
guard.relent: …Right. Go on, then. Keep to the road and don't make me regret it.

crossings.intro: A timber gate across the road, a warden's post beside it, and a warden already walking out to meet you.

choices.text: Show the warrant you are carrying
choices.success: The seal is checked twice and the bar comes up.

choices.text: Give your names
choices.success: The warden has heard the names. The bar comes up faster than it should.

choices.text: Make it worth the warden's evening
choices.success: The coin goes somewhere it will not be found. The bar comes up.

choices.text: Bluff your way past
choices.success: The story is thin but told well. The warden decides not to look at it too hard.
choices.failure: The story falls apart at the third question.

choices.text: Go through the post
choices.success: The gate is opened the loud way.
